optimized_sql:
SELECT item.i_item_id,
       avg(store_sales.ss_quantity) agg1,
       avg(store_sales.ss_list_price) agg2,
       avg(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) agg3,
       avg(store_sales.ss_sales_price) agg4
FROM store_sales
JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
JOIN item ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
WHERE date_dim.d_year = 2001
  AND store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk IN (
      SELECT customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk
      FROM customer_demographics
      WHERE customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'F'
        AND customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W'
        AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'College'
  )
  AND store_sales.ss_promo_sk IN (
      SELECT promotion.p_promo_sk
      FROM promotion
      WHERE (promotion.p_channel_email = 'N' OR promotion.p_channel_event = 'N')
  )
GROUP BY item.i_item_id
ORDER BY item.i_item_id
LIMIT 100
